basic_info.description: Welcome to this charming 2-bedroom, 1-bathroom home located in the sought-after Miraloma Park neighborhood. Spanning 1,293 sq. ft., this residence offers a blend of comfort and functionality. The kitchen is well-equipped with modern appliances including an electric cooktop, granite countertops, dishwasher, garbage disposal, microwave, oven, and refrigerator. Enjoy meals in the formal dining room, perfect for gatherings. The bathroom features double sinks, marble finishes, a skylight, and a stall shower. Flooring throughout the home consists of hardwood, laminate, and marble, providing both style and durability. Stay cozy in the living area with the central forced air heating and a fireplace. Additional amenities include a security gate and convenient in-garage laundry facilities. The large lot also offers potential opportunities for horizontal or vertical expansion. The garage offers endless possibilities for a home office, guest quarters, gym, or recreation room. Ideal location near Miraloma Elementary & Playground, Mt. Davidson hiking trails & views, Glen Park Village & BART, West Portal & Noe Valley offer shops, cafes, restaurants & ample amenities plus easy freeway & transit access. Don't miss the opportunity to own this delightful home in this prime San Francisco location.
